# p0_looker_ai_staged (Resource)

A staged Looker installation for agentic access. Staging generates the identifiers needed to deploy P0's Looker connector.

Use the read-only `secret_manager` connector attributes to deploy the connector's Cloud Run service and grant it read on the Admin key's secret. Once the connector is deployed and the Admin key is in its secret, create a `p0_looker_ai` resource with the same `id` to complete the installation.

**Prerequisite:** P0 must be installed on the Google Cloud organization (for example via the `p0_gcp` resource).

**Note:** This integration is currently in preview.

For the full install steps, see [Looker](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/resource-integrations/agentic-gateway/mcp-server/looker).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the p0_gcp integration to already be installed for the same
# organization.

resource "p0_gcp" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456789012"
}

resource "p0_looker_ai_staged" "example" {
  id           = "acme"
  instance_url = "https://acme.looker.app"
  # The Google Secret Manager secret that will hold the Looker Admin key.
  admin_key_secret = "p0_install_looker_acme_admin-key"

  secret_manager = {
    type       = "gcp-sm"
    project_id = "my-project-id"
  }

  depends_on = [p0_gcp.example]
}

# See the p0_looker_ai example for the next steps (deploying the connector,
# and adding the Admin key to its secret) that complete the install.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin_key_secret` (String) The ID of the Google Secret Manager secret, in `secret_manager.project_id`, that holds the Looker API key of a Looker service account with the Admin role. Only the connector reads it, never P0.
- `id` (String) An identifier for the Looker instance, made of letters, digits and hyphens. P0 puts it in the name of every secret that it makes.
- `instance_url` (String) The base URL of the Looker (Google Cloud core) instance, `https://<name>.looker.app`, in lowercase with no path or trailing slash. P0 reaches the instance over the internet, so it needs a public endpoint. Custom domains and ports aren't supported.
- `secret_manager` (Attributes) Where P0's Looker connector runs and where the Looker instance's Admin key is stored (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_manager))

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed

<a id="nestedatt--secret_manager"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_manager`

Required:

- `project_id` (String) The GCP project that hosts the connector's Cloud Run service and the secret that holds the Looker instance's Admin key.
- `type` (String) The secret manager that stores the Looker instance's Admin key. Only `gcp-sm` (Google Secret Manager) is supported.

Read-Only:

- `connector_region` (String) The GCP region in which to deploy the connector's Cloud Run service
- `connector_service_account` (String) The email of the GCP service account that the connector must run as
- `connector_service_name` (String) The name to give the connector's Cloud Run service
